more_info.overview: Karaya gum is used as an emulsifier in food. Its technological role is to help oil and water remain mixed.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, chewing gum, sauces, potato- cereal- flour- or starch-based snacks. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.origin: Collected as dried gum exudate from suitable Sterculia or Cochlospermum species. It contains acetylated plant polysaccharides.
more_info.dietary_restrictions: The specified starting material is plant derived and compatible with vegetarian and vegan diets. The specification does not establish halal or kosher certification.
